notes.title: WISH US LUCK - FULL GAME KEYS GIVEAWAY
notes.notes:
Wish Us Luck is a multi-plot interactive fiction coming out on July 5th. 
We invited Twitch streamer TheThorunnX to play it live. 
Wish us Luck producer will join the party to introduce the game and answer chat questions.
Watch it for a chance to get the full game for free! 
And don't forget to Wishlist it!
